div.head: VII Atr 2.2
div.ab: Et eat omnis presbiter cum populo suo ad processionem tribus diebus nudis pedibus.
Et eat omnis presbiter cum populo suo ad processionem tribus diebus nudis pedibus.
Et eat omnis presbyter cum populo suo ad processionem tribus diebus nudis pedibus.
Und jeder Pfarrer schreite mit seinem Volke zur Procession barfuss an den drei Tagen.
And let every priest go with his people in procession barefoot on the three days.
And every priest shall go barefoot in the Procession with his people on the three days.
And for three days every priest is to go barefoot in the procession along with his people.
div.note: Liebermann compares VIIa Atr 2.1.; AX: pages in Rabin (text / translation), checked against Rabin (our double-read transcription), October 2026 (e.g. was “180”, now “180 / 181”; 4 rows of VII Atr)
This clause has no equivalent in 7a Æthelred.
